title: LoRa Soil Sensor Network with a Long-Range Gateway
description: Connects battery-powered soil sensors to a gateway kilometres away over LoRa, and measures packet loss, range and battery life under different spreading factors.

title: Motor Current Signature Monitor for Early Fault Warning
description: Samples motor current and looks for frequency patterns that signal bearing wear or imbalance, raising a warning when the pattern drifts from a recorded healthy baseline.

title: Smart Plug Energy Logger with Standby Detection
description: Measures power drawn by an appliance through a smart plug, identifies standby consumption and shows how much a household could save by switching idle devices off.

title: Classroom CO2 Ventilation Advisor
description: Reads carbon dioxide levels in a room and tells occupants when to open windows, showing a clear traffic-light display and logging levels through each lesson.

title: TinyML Anomaly Detector on a Microcontroller
description: Trains a small model on vibration data and runs it directly on the microcontroller, reporting memory footprint, inference time and false alarms compared with sending raw data to the cloud.

title: Over-the-Air Firmware Update Server with Rollback
description: Delivers signed firmware updates to a fleet of devices in staged waves, verifies each image before installing and automatically reverts a device that fails to report healthy after update.

title: MQTT Broker Load and Retained Message Study
description: Benchmarks an MQTT broker with many simulated clients, comparing quality-of-service levels and the effect of retained messages and persistent sessions on latency and memory.

title: Smart Locker Compartment Controller
description: Controls a bank of lockers with electronic latches, assigns compartments to one-time codes and keeps an audit log of every open and close event.

title: Water Meter Pulse Counter with Leak Detection
description: Counts pulses from a household water meter, learns the normal daily pattern and flags continuous low flow overnight as a probable leak.

title: Cold Storage Door-Open Alert System
description: Detects when a cold room door stays open too long using a magnetic sensor and temperature rise, and sends escalating alerts until it is closed.

title: Photoperiod Light Controller for Indoor Plants
description: Switches grow lights on a schedule that follows each plant's day-length needs and adjusts automatically through the seasons, with a manual override.

title: Indoor Positioning from WiFi Signal Fingerprints
description: Estimates which room a device is in by comparing live WiFi signal strengths with a fingerprint database collected beforehand, and reports accuracy by room size.

title: Store-and-Forward Telemetry Gateway
description: Buffers sensor readings to local storage when the network drops and forwards them in order when it returns, without duplicating or losing records.

title: Digital Twin Dashboard for a Lab Bench Experiment
description: Mirrors a physical heating experiment in a live model, compares predicted and measured temperatures in real time and highlights when the two diverge.

title: BLE Badge Attendance Tracker for Workshops
description: Records who is present in a room from the Bluetooth badges they wear and produces attendance summaries, while letting people opt out and deleting raw data after a set period.

title: WiFi LED Matrix Notice Board
description: Displays scrolling messages on an LED matrix that anyone with permission can update from a simple web page, with scheduling for when each message appears.

title: Home Network Device Inventory via mDNS
description: Discovers smart devices on a local network using service announcements, lists what each exposes and flags devices that appeared without being registered.

title: Bicycle Tracker with GPS and Motion Alarm
description: Wakes on movement while a bike is locked, reports its position through a cellular module at low power and shows the track on a map.

title: RFID Parking Barrier Controller
description: Opens a barrier for registered cards, logs each entry and exit and refuses cards that are expired or already inside, using a small local database.

title: Calibrated Weather Station with Uncertainty Estimates
description: Calibrates temperature and humidity sensors against a reference, publishes readings with an error estimate and shows how calibration changes the data.

title: Thermal Comfort Index Display
description: Combines temperature, humidity and air movement into a comfort index and shows whether a room feels too warm, too cold or comfortable.

title: Wind Turbine Model Telemetry Lab
description: Instruments a small model turbine with speed and power sensors and charts its power curve across wind speeds, comparing measured output with the theoretical limit.

title: Hydroponic pH and EC Dosing Controller
description: Keeps nutrient solution within target pH and conductivity ranges by dosing small amounts with pumps, with safeguards that prevent over-dosing when a sensor fails.

title: Quiet Room Sound Level Event Detector
description: Measures sound level in a study room, flags sustained noise above a threshold and shows a calm indicator, without ever recording speech.

title: Secure Device Provisioning with Per-Device Certificates
description: Gives every device its own certificate during first boot through a controlled enrolment flow, and shows that revoking one device does not affect the others.

title: Mesh Network Routing Simulator for Sensor Nodes
description: Simulates sensor nodes that relay each other's messages and compares routing strategies on delivery rate, hop count and energy use as nodes fail.

title: Battery Life Estimator for Duty-Cycled Sensors
description: Predicts how long a sensor node will run from its sleep and active currents and reporting interval, and validates the estimate against measured discharge.

title: Pump Dry-Run Protection Controller
description: Stops a water pump when flow or current shows it is running dry, retries after a delay and counts trips so repeated faults are reported to the owner.
